properties.label_detail_en: Abd al-Karim built his capital at Wara (WP:Wadai_Sultanate). Not a border. Founded c.1611–55 in Bornu's orbit; expanded under Jawda 1747–95 (GHA V pp.511–513); buffer kingdoms separated Wadai and Darfur (pp.187–188).
properties.label_detail_ar: بنى عبد الكريم عاصمته في وارا (ويكيبيديا). ليست حداً. تأسست نحو 1611–1655 في فلك برنو؛ وتوسعت في عهد جودة 1747–1795؛ وفصلت ممالك عازلة بين وداي ودارفور. [Arabic text pending native-speaker review.]

properties.label_detail_en: Sultan Sharif made Abéché the capital (WP:Wadai_Sultanate); year not given there, so shown for the whole era. Not a border. Founded c.1611–55 in Bornu's orbit; expanded under Jawda 1747–95 (GHA V pp.511–513); buffer kingdoms separated Wadai and Darfur (pp.187–188).
